decision_conditions: Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate compliance with the stated Condition (4).  It is held that the submitted details fail to accord with policy requirements in line with the Council's adopted standards to ensure that tree protection is implemented to acceptable standards within the development to preserve the character of the heritage asset. It is therefore considered that the submission fails to comply with policies DMD80 of the Development Management Document (2014), CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010), G7 of the London Plan (2021) as well as the advice contained within the NPPF (2024).
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 24/02197/FUL: tree protection (4) in respect of erection of free-standing fencing and gates to 3.1m in height, to create secure garden area, removal of existing fencing alongside removal of 2 existing shipping containers.
